policies.title: Store Policies & Guidelines
policies.deliveryText: We provide 100% FREE express delivery across all states in India with ₹0 shipping charges on every order. Orders within Gujarat are delivered within 1-2 working days. Orders to other Indian states are delivered within 2-3 working days through trusted courier partners.
policies.returnsTitle: Strict No Return & No Exchange Policy
policies.returnsText: At Chamunda Fashion, we take immense pride in checking the fabric quality, stitching, and finishing of every single garment before packaging. Therefore, WE DO NOT ACCEPT ANY RETURNS OR EXCHANGES. Please check our detailed size chart (bust, waist, hip, length) before ordering.
policies.paymentText: We currently do NOT offer Cash on Delivery (COD). All orders must be prepaid through direct UPI QR code or UPI ID. Orders are dispatched after manual verification of the 12-digit UTR and payment screenshot.
policies.privacyText: Your name, phone number, address, and payment receipts are used solely for packing, dispatching your parcels, and sending WhatsApp status updates. We never share or sell customer data.
